central_question: Can multistable folded structures implement composable binary and ternary mechanical logic?
claims_and_limits: Wang et al. report seven logic gates and binary and ternary half- and full-adders using two Kresling configurations and torsional transitions.
Published November 5, accepted October 14; the citable early-access version is subject to further edits.
Laboratory modules and conceptual illustrations do not establish processor speed, lifetime or scalable arbitrary circuit depth.

visual.shared_motif: Terracotta Kresling folded modules; cover is a workshop scene, inner is a separate engineering notebook showing multistability, torsion and module composition.
visual.status: Conceptual illustration, not a reproduction of apparatus geometry or truth tables.
